documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers has transitioned from a trading-led model to a manufacturing-driven company following the commencement of commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management aims to scale manufacturing utilization to 100% by the end of FY27 and shift the revenue mix to a 50-50 split between manufacturing and trading. The company is focusing on debt reduction using internal accruals and plans to expand its product portfolio into non-textile industries. Despite global macro uncertainties, the company remains optimistic about domestic demand and its ability to pass on raw material cost increases. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting revenue of 11,020.3 lakhs and profit after tax of 1,215.4 lakhs for FY26.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 50-50 revenue mix between manufacturing and trading.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margins are expected to increase by 2% to 3% in the coming years.
guidance.quote: See as I've been already mentioned the basis -- basically when we are doing the manufacturing, naturally the profit margin is little bit higher in the manufacturing segment. So, overall profit margin you can consider it 2% to 3% will be higher in the coming years.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA margins are expected to be near about 50% according to production.
guidance.quote: And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: Management expects trading and manufacturing to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: Turnover from manufacturing at full utilization with 500-ton capacity is expected to reach around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Growth in the wood coating market is expected to be 20% to 30%.
guidance.quote: And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment is cautious due to global macro uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Global brands are increasingly diversifying their sourcing base towards India, supporting long-term demand.
demand_outlook.quote: With competing manufacturing hubs facing challenges such as rising costs, compliance pressures and supply- side disruptions, global brands are increasingly diversifying their sourcing base towards India.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile ink and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has scope to expand manufacturing capacity by installing additional vessels for an investment of INR 3-5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, featuring an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The new facility has a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant spread over 10 acres.
capex_expansion.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Expansion is planned within the next 6 months to potentially make domestic binders or ink.
capex_expansion.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs have been volatile due to global supply disruptions.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: ✓Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices have not shown significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the Vadodara facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization reached around 60% in the first two months (November and December) after starting manufacturing.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the INR50 crores manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a bank loan and INR20 crores was funded through IPO for land purchase and internal accruals/unsecured promoter loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: It of course internal accruals. As huge capex is not required. So there is no need to go for the huge capex.

capital_allocation.claim: The expected payback period for the INR40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate poses a currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

management_commitments.claim: Reach full capacity utilization of the Vadodara plant.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: Launch new products following R&D trials.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Trading and manufacturing revenues are expected to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: New product manufacturing expansion has been planned within the next 6 months.
management_commitments.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a fully manufacturing unit considering by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: See, we will establish fully manufacturing unit considering by 2030.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
